dogecoin.text: Bitcoin rose by over 3% in the past 24 hours. Dogecoin led the rally with a 4% surge, while Solana and ether posted gains of around 3.8% and 2.3%. Thursday’s rebound provided a boost to bullish sentiment following a turbulent week. https://t.co/xfmd5jruae
